name: Glory Hole Barista
summary:
A short, sweet, 3D simulation game about a café with a "unique" marketing strategy! And in case you were wondering, no, you won't be serving coffee...

If a customer buys five coffees, they get to use the glory hole down the hall. As the plucky barista, you must satisfy the specific needs of each client.

Choose between your skills to target specific desires. But be careful: each action must be replenished, so you'll need to stay cool and plan ahead.

Match your partner's intensity to build their pleasure. Balance their desires, lube, and intensity to unlock higher orgasm ranks. Satisfy customers to level up your abilities and unlock new actions!

Use rewards to access several different outfits to customize your look.

Featuring story scenes with 3 romanceable characters!
